tasks.spec:
You are a test-tooling engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, never call a billed model or the network, never edit anything under storygame/, data/ or docs/. You own ONLY: scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_probe.py, scripts/ringer/phase1/check_act2_probe.py, tests/test_act2_probe.py. First run: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv ; then use `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_act2_probe.py` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` / `-m ruff check <files>`.

CONTEXT. scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_probe.py is a bounded live-smoke probe for Act 2 scenes 2A, 2B, 2C of data/stories/continuity-initiative. Its `_state(package, scene_id)` builds a synthetic scene arrival; for 2C it asserts CARRIED_FACTS_2C, which is the clean "Brandon's name kept" exit of 2B (fact brandon_name_kept). There is no way to arrive at 2C as if the player had let Brandon erase his name in 2B, so the erased-name slice cannot be smoked. The real 2B erase realization (SL-2B-B-R5 in data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml) asserts the same facts as the kept realization (SL-2B-B-R4) EXCEPT that it asserts brandon_name_erased instead of brandon_name_kept and additionally asserts evidence_gap_development_record. The 2C opening screen does NOT differ by ledger. The ledger shows in the earned observation instead: knowledge entry k_sl_2c_c_r1 (data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml) has delivery_variants chosen by the true facts. With brandon_name_kept the delivered text contains "He says it coldly and avoids Kristin's eyes."; with brandon_name_erased it contains "He glances at Kristin as he says it." The observation is delivered on the player's first reply to Rebecca (reveal k_sl_2c_c_r1 appears in a turn's committed_reveals). A player who never earns it sees neither sentence. Do NOT invent or append entry lines in the probe.

YOUR JOB: add a ledger option, default behaviour unchanged.
1. act2_probe.py: add a module constant for the erased 2C carry set (CARRIED_FACTS_2C with brandon_name_kept replaced by brandon_name_erased, plus evidence_gap_development_record; keep every other fact). Add a keyword parameter `ledger: str = "kept"` (values "kept" or "erased") to `run(...)` (last parameter, after prefix), thread it to `_state` and into the result row as a new field `ledger` (add it to ROW_FIELDS). `ledger="erased"` is valid only for scene 2C; for any other scene raise ValueError("ledger erased applies only to scene 2C"). Unknown ledger values raise ValueError. Add `--ledger` (choices kept, erased, default kept) to the CLI and pass it through. Everything else (caps, prefixes, scripted dry player, billing guard, --confirm rule) stays exactly as is.
2. check_act2_probe.py: validate that each row's `ledger` is "kept" or "erased" (a row WITHOUT the field counts as "kept", so old artifacts still pass). For a scene 2C row whose turns include a committed reveal k_sl_2c_c_r1, require that the response text of THAT turn (the row's `responses` entry for that turn index) contains the matching sentence above and not the other ledger's sentence. If k_sl_2c_c_r1 was never committed, require neither. Error messages must start with "WHY <row_id>:" like the existing ones. Do not weaken any existing check. Do not change what `_entry_screen` returns.
3. tests/test_act2_probe.py: add tests (do not delete or weaken any): (a) a dry run of scene 2C with ledger="erased" reaches 3A and passes the checker, and the row has ledger "erased"; (b) `_state(package, "2C", "erased")` has true facts brandon_name_erased and evidence_gap_development_record and NOT brandon_name_kept, and the kept state is unchanged; (c) ledger="erased" with scene 2A raises ValueError, and an unknown ledger raises ValueError; (d) the checker rejects a doctored 2C row (build it from a dry-run row) whose k_sl_2c_c_r1 turn response carries the wrong ledger's sentence, and accepts the right one; (e) the real package selects the right delivery sentence per ledger: call the same delivery-text selection the engine uses for k_sl_2c_c_r1 (find it in storygame/ by searching for delivery_variants usage; do not reimplement it) with the kept and the erased fact sets and assert each sentence. Use the existing helper style in that file. Player commands in tests stay imperative first-person text. The dry scripted player's canned provider text may not contain the sentences; that is fine, so for (a) the checker must not require them unless the response text is the engine's real delivery.

OUTPUT. Leave changes uncommitted. Run ruff format on every Python file you touch. The harness check runs the focused tests, a CLI dry run of both ledgers, ruff, confirms nothing outside your three files changed, and exports a patch.
tasks.check:
set -o pipefail
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp
PY=.venv/bin/python
git status --porcelain | grep -v '^?? .venv$' | awk '{print $2}' | sort > /tmp/chg.$$
printf '%s\n' scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_probe.py scripts/ringer/phase1/check_act2_probe.py tests/test_act2_probe.py | sort > /tmp/alw.$$
[ -z "$(comm -23 /tmp/chg.$$ /tmp/alw.$$)" ] || { echo "WHY: files outside ownership changed:"; comm -23 /tmp/chg.$$ /tmp/alw.$$; exit 1; }
grep -q act2_probe.py /tmp/chg.$$ || { echo "WHY: act2_probe.py was not changed"; exit 1; }
$PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_act2_probe.py tests/test_act2_knowledge_sources.py > /tmp/pt.$$ 2>&1; RC=$?
tail -25 /tmp/pt.$$
[ $RC -eq 0 ] || { echo "WHY: focused tests failed"; exit 1; }
set -a; source /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.env 2>/dev/null; set +a
for L in kept erased; do
  OUT=/tmp/act2-ledger-$L-$$; rm -rf $OUT
  $PY scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_probe.py --scene 2C --prefix none --n 1 --ledger $L --dry-run --out $OUT || { echo "WHY: CLI dry run failed for ledger $L"; exit 1; }
  $PY scripts/ringer/phase1/check_act2_probe.py $OUT 1 --mode dry || { echo "WHY: checker failed on dry $L artifact"; exit 1; }
  $PY - "$OUT" "$L" <<'INNER' || exit 1
import json, sys
row = json.load(open(sys.argv[1] + "/results.json"))["rows"][0]
assert row.get("ledger") == sys.argv[2], f"WHY: row ledger {row.get('ledger')!r} != {sys.argv[2]!r}"
facts = set(row["final_true_facts"])
want = "brandon_name_erased" if sys.argv[2] == "erased" else "brandon_name_kept"
other = "brandon_name_kept" if sys.argv[2] == "erased" else "brandon_name_erased"
assert want in facts and other not in facts, f"WHY: ledger facts wrong: {sorted(facts)}"
print("ledger", sys.argv[2], "ok")
INNER
done
$PY scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_probe.py --scene 2A --prefix none --n 1 --ledger erased --dry-run --out /tmp/act2-ledger-bad-$$ >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "WHY: erased ledger on 2A must fail"; exit 1; }
F="scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_probe.py scripts/ringer/phase1/check_act2_probe.py tests/test_act2_probe.py"
$PY -m ruff format --check $F && $PY -m ruff check $F || exit 1
OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/act2-visible-moves
mkdir -p $OUT && git add $F && git diff --cached > $OUT/ledger-probe.patch && wc -l $OUT/ledger-probe.patch && git diff --cached --stat | tail -4
